announcements.html: Effective Wednesday 4 November 2026 14:00 UTC, Deribit will implement a change to the Coinbase crypto index calculation used for crypto perpetual contracts.
announcements.text: Effective Wednesday 4 November 2026 14:00 UTC, Deribit will implement a change to the Coinbase crypto index calculation used for crypto perpetual contracts.
announcements.title: Coinbase Index Price Methodology Update

list_announcements.name: list_announcements

parameters.description: Only announcements published before this time, to look back. The newest if left empty.

parameters.name: limit

html.description: The announcement as Deribit wrote it, in HTML.

latest_published_at.description: When the newest was published, as ISO 8601 in UTC, such as 2026-10-22T08:00:00.000Z.

list_currencies.description: List every currency Deribit supports, BTC, ETH, USDC and USDT first: its name, whether it counts as collateral, its yield when it earns one, and its withdrawal fee and networks. Use a code in any Currency field. No API key required.
list_currencies.name: list_currencies

currencies.description: Every currency, BTC, ETH, USDC and USDT first, then the rest A to Z.

currency.description: The currency code, such as BTC. Use it in any Currency field.

min_withdrawal_fee.description: The smallest fee for a withdrawal, in the currency.

list_delivery_prices.description: List the prices an index's contracts were settled at when they expired, day by day, newest first (Deribit's contracts expire at 08:00 UTC). Skip the newest to page back through years of them. No API key required.

list_delivery_prices.name: list_delivery_prices

list_instruments.description: List what Deribit has listed for a currency: futures, perpetuals, options, spot pairs and combos, soonest expiry first, each with its expiry, strike, contract size, tick size, units and fees. Narrow it to one expiry or to calls or puts, or list the contracts that expired recently instead. The first future in the list is the nearest to expiry. No API key required.
list_instruments.name: list_instruments

Narrow it to one expiry for an option chain, or list the futures for the curve, sorted by volume, open interest, expiry or name. No API key required.

description: Read public market data from Deribit, the largest crypto options exchange: live tickers with implied volatility and greeks, order books, trades, price candles, futures and options listings, option chains, perpetual funding, the DVOL volatility index, realized volatility, index and delivery prices, settlements, exchange volumes and announcements. No account or API key, and no access to anyone's balances or orders.

deribit_price_crosses_level_trigger.description: Runs when an instrument's mark price, such as BTC-PERPETUAL's, or an index price, such as btc_usd, crosses a level you pick: up through it, down through it, or either. A level the price is already past when the workflow is turned on waits for the price to come back across it.

output.direction: up when it rose through the level, down when it fell.
output.index_price: The underlying index price at the same moment.
output.market: The instrument or index watched, such as BTC-PERPETUAL.
output.previous_price: The price at the poll before, on the other side.
output.price_currency: The currency of the prices, such as USD.
output.price_source: mark price for an instrument, index price for an index.
output.time: When the price was read, as ISO 8601 in UTC.
output.timestamp_ms: The same moment in milliseconds since 1970.

parameters.description: What to watch: an instrument in capitals, such as BTC-PERPETUAL or BTC-27NOV26 (its mark price), or an index in lower case, such as btc_usd (its index price).
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: The price to watch for, in the instrument's price currency (US dollars for BTC-PERPETUAL and btc_usd, BTC for a BTC option), such as 100000.
parameters.name: level

parameters.description: up to run when the price rises through the level, down when it falls through it. Leave it empty to run either way.
parameters.name: direction
